steps: Sign in to the Claude Console (platform.claude.com)
Name the key, choose an expiration and set 'Linked account' to yourself
Copy the key (Anthropic keys normally begin with 'sk-ant-') - it is shown exactly once
If the check answers 400, the key may need to be tied to a workspace in the Console; the key is not necessarily bad

least_privilege.summary: Create the key inside the workspace for this project, with an expiration, so it can be revoked alone.
